method: Closed-loop fixed concurrent request slots, recorded Korean audio, real Whisper + planner + validated state + Polly. Each request has a fresh session. Includes HTTP session creation and SSH tunnel RTT. Not concurrent always-listening users. Serving mode is recorded separately; baseline serializes planning, replicas route independent requests, vLLM uses continuous batching. Load sample pool differs from 31-case quality suite.
